lt.hints.gatling_graphite_vm: Port 2003 is the Graphite listener of VictoriaMetrics (-graphiteListenAddr); Prometheus has none.
lt.hints.gatling_relabel: The relabeling pack expects -relabelConfig rules in VictoriaMetrics (docs/load-tests.md); the run tag is -Dgatling.core.outputDirectoryBaseName in the Gatling template.
lt.hints.influx2_plugins: This tool writes to InfluxDB 2 through plugins; set them up following the tool documentation.
lt.hints.influx_auth: If InfluxDB requires a login, set K6_INFLUXDB_USERNAME and K6_INFLUXDB_PASSWORD.
lt.hints.influx_graphite: InfluxDB accepts Graphite only with the graphite input enabled and a gatling.* template.
lt.hints.jmeter_influx: In the Backend Listener (InfluxdbBackendListenerClient) set influxdbUrl={url}/write?db={database} and application={property}: then LoadLens tells the run apart.
lt.hints.jmeter_prometheus: JMeter writes to Prometheus only through a plugin; the built-in Backend Listener writes to InfluxDB.
lt.hints.k6_influx2: Output to InfluxDB 2 needs a k6 build with the xk6-output-influxdb extension; set the token in K6_INFLUXDB_TOKEN.
lt.hints.locust_exporter: Locust metrics are collected by locust_exporter: add it to the Prometheus scrape config, no launch flags are needed.
lt.hints.locust_influx: Locust needs a third-party plugin (locust-plugins) for InfluxDB; there is no built-in output.
lt.hints.network: The addresses are as LoadLens sees them: from the generator they may differ.
lt.hints.no_source: The Load domain has no source configured: {error}
lt.hints.prometheus_rw: Prometheus must accept remote write: the --web.enable-remote-write-receiver flag.
lt.hints.supported_tools: Suggestions exist for k6, JMeter, Gatling and Locust.

lt.tool.gatling.help: Gatling bundle up to 3.10 inclusive; the scripts directory is user-files/simulations of the bundle. Pass JVM properties of the simulation in the JAVA_OPTS variable. Gatling metrics are told apart by the run window; how to tag them when writing to VictoriaMetrics is described in docs/load-tests.md. Code 2 means the assertions failed.
lt.tool.gatling.title: Gatling (bundle)
lt.tool.gatling_maven.help: A project with gatling-maven-plugin; Gatling 3.11+ bundles are built this way too. The scripts directory is the project root with pom.xml and mvnw. Pass simulation properties as -Dname=value.
lt.tool.jmeter.help: Non-GUI mode. For LoadLens to tell the run metrics apart, the application field of the Backend Listener must read a property: ${__P(application,my-app)}. Pass test properties as -Jname=value.
lt.tool.k6.help: Set the metric output in the parameters: --out experimental-prometheus-rw (the address goes to K6_PROMETHEUS_RW_SERVER_URL) or --out influxdb=http://…/k6. LoadLens adds the testid tag with the run name itself. Code 99 means the thresholds were not passed; the report is built anyway.
lt.tool.locust.help: Set --users, --spawn-rate and --run-time, otherwise the test runs until it is stopped or reaches the duration limit. Locust metrics come through locust_exporter and are told apart only by the run window.
